I can't request a refund on order 1005 because it is still pending and hasn't been paid. Refunds are only available for paid orders. Once the order is paid, you can ask again for a refund within 30 days of the order date.

If you believe the order was charged, or you have concerns about the damaged item, I can send your case to a human reviewer. Just tell me and I'll pass it along.
